_comment: The mesh build as one declaration for the klt functional-verification path (issue #109): the compile units, toplevel, testbench and the launch options shared by all three requests in ../requests/. verification/fv.sh assembles each request from this file plus the request's own content, rewriting the repo-root-relative paths here relative to the request copy's directory (verification/requests/, where its paths resolve). What distinguishes the requests -- parameters.DEPTH, options.defines, options.random_seed, env.MESH_MODES/MESH_DEPTH -- stays in the request files, as does engine. Only fv.sh reads this file; the Python bench path owns the same invariants in lib_bench.py (issue #90).
